newsitem.title: USA: Andrx raises $22.4 mln in private placement.
newsitem.headline: Andrx raises $22.4 mln in private placement.

text.p: Andrx Corp said Tuesday it raised $22.4 million gross proceeds from the private placement of 1.33 million common shares.

It said a large West Coast investment management firm, which it did not identify, has agreed to buy 730,000 of its common shares. In addition, Watson Pharmaceuticals Inc has purchased 600,000 shares, the generic pharmaceuticals maker said.
Both transactions were for $25.50 a share, the closing price of its stock on June 11, it said.
It said Watson bought the shares from the company and from three of its founders. The purchase will raise Watson's stake in the company to 18.5 percent, it said.
